$comment: Machine-checkable claim registry. scripts/check_site.py greps the built HTML for every pattern here. 'do-not-publish' and 'unresolved' patterns MUST NOT appear in output unless the entry carries an explicit ownerDecision. This is the enforcement layer for data/content-inventory.json → flags_for_pcc; it exists so an unresolved fact cannot reach production by being typed into a template.

claims.why: The legacy PCC pages gave conflicting addresses. Kathy Suarez resolved the conflict in the governing August 13, 2026 client revision by approving 2490 Country View Glen, Escondido, CA 92026.
claims.ownerDecision: The owner directed that Kathy Suarez's current Google Doc is the website truth. Revision 4210, modified August 13, 2026, explicitly approves this mailing address.
claims.siteHandling: Publish the approved Escondido mailing address on the Donate page.

claims.why: This was the conflicting legacy address. Kathy Suarez replaced it with 2490 Country View Glen in the governing August 13, 2026 client revision.
claims.siteHandling: Keep the stale address absent from every public page.

claims.why: PCC's Focus and Programs pages say ages 5–17; the FAQ page says 5–15. Two published values, unreconciled. Resolving by choosing one would be an agent-made fact.
claims.ownerDecision: Kathy Suarez's governing 2026-08-12 client revision explicitly uses ages 5 to 17 in the approved About and partnership copy; the owner directed that Kathy's latest document is the website truth.
claims.siteHandling: Use ages 5 to 17 where the governing client revision specifies it.

claims.why: The legacy FAQ used ages 5 to 15. Kathy Suarez approved ages 5 to 17 in the governing client revision.
claims.siteHandling: Keep the stale age range absent from every public page.

claims.why: The live site no longer states Alpha FC's 2024 figure (it now says 'close to 200'). The old 180 has no current source, and the 2024 per-program split is unconfirmed.
claims.siteHandling: Program shows the current published 'close to 200'; Impact shows only the org-wide 2024 total PCC published (215).

claims.why: Publication months were inferred from WordPress upload paths, not published by PCC. Inference is not provenance.
claims.siteHandling: Letters display their subject year (from the title) and no publication date.

claims.why: The film's subject appears to be a named program participant. Child-subject consent posture is unconfirmed, and the CMS guardrail forbids publishing a story about a child without confirmed consent.
claims.siteHandling: Film record retained with consentStatus 'pending'; withheld from all rendered pages until PCC confirms.

claims.why: Departments for the three newly-named Alpha FC communities are not stated on the live site. Santa Rosa de Cabal is in Risaralda in public geography, but PCC has not published it as program data.
claims.siteHandling: Communities render by name only; the department field stays empty.

claims.why: Kathy Suarez's governing client document supplies a rounded annual comparison for 2022 through 2025, backed by the repository-owned annual reports.
claims.ownerDecision: The owner explicitly directed that Kathy's latest Google Doc is the governing truth for the website. The current revision was verified on 2026-08-15.
claims.siteHandling: Publish only the rounded values Kathy supplied for each year, preserve annual-letter wording outside Transparency, and identify that the comparison values are rounded.

claims.why: No Form 990 or financial statement is published anywhere on PCC's site; linking or referencing one would imply a document that is not available.
claims.siteHandling: Documents list contains only the four annual reports, Our Beginnings, and the Privacy Policy.

patterns: ES Futsal is now Alpha FC

claims.siteHandling: The letters publish PCC's own historical wording verbatim; the site never asserts the two are the same organization.

claims.why: Caption/subtitle availability on the six films is unconfirmed, and the accessibility gate requires captions before films are embedded.
claims.siteHandling: Films link out to YouTube rather than embedding; no caption claim is made on the site.

claims.why: Causal and promotional impact language PCC has not published. Trust-critical nonprofit copy states what was counted, not what it caused.
claims.siteHandling: Impact narrative uses PCC's own observational language.

claims.why: PCC has not published per-dollar impact equivalents. Inventing them would misrepresent how funds are used.
